text:
alicia: quick sync — i'm proposing we add a tiny ingress header `x-rw-cost-hint` that carries minimal billing context to avoid late-enrich lookup gaps. sketch below, it's intentionally compact. thoughts?

maya: fwiw the problem is real, queries blow up when billing keys are missing. curious about privacy/compliance implications. :thinking_face:

oli: we already have a big provenance envelope but it gets stripped/trimmed at edges. small header sounds plausible if we keep it opaque and short. runtime cost should be negligible.

sasha: agree small header helps attribution, but we need a deterministic fallback. sampling + late enrich currently can attribute to fallback tenant which skews cost by up to ~15% in some buckets.

ben: suggestion — keep header to two fields: `tenant_hash` (sha1 prefix) and `workload_tier` (prod|dev). no PII, constant length. e.g. `rwch:abc123, tier:prod`

alicia: exact sketch: ```
X-RW-COST-HINT: rwid=3f2a1c;t=t0
# rwid = first 6 hex of sha256(tenant_id), t = workload tier tag (p0/p1/p2)
```
keeps header <= 24 bytes.

maya: ok but how do we join that downstream? late-enrich service would map rwid -> tenant if available, otherwise route to hashed-bucket chargeback. do we keep mapping live in ingest or offline?

oli: runtime option: keep a tiny in-memory mapping in the stitcher with TTL 24h from recent resolves. fallback to shard-by-rwid for allocation if missing. avoids immediate offline lookup.

sasha: concern: cardinality explosion if attackers send arbitrary rwid values. we need a cap and eviction policy plus validate when signed by our edge. also drop unknown formats at edge.

ben: we can require edge to sign header with HMAC short tag so stitcher only accepts headers with valid tag. tag adds 10 bytes but prevents garbage. signature key rotates via k8s secret.

alicia: tradeoffs: + cheap attribution for common cases, + fewer heavy late-enrich lookups, + privacy preserved (no tenant ids). downsides: extra header plumbing, rollout complexity, key management.

maya: operational questions: metrics to track before/after: fraction of traces with cost_hint, fraction resolved to tenant vs fallback, and query cost for unresolved traces. we should A/B on a small subset first.

deploy-bot: canary deploy of header consumer to staging scheduled: 2025-06-10 18:00 UTC (job id: deploy-8932) :white_check_mark:

sasha: also update SDKs + http proxies to emit header where available. mobile SDK may not have tenant id at that stage — ok to omit.

ben: for billing pipeline, we treat `rwid` as first-class key: when absent use current logic. when present but unresolved, attribute to `rwid-shard-<N>` until resolve or TTL expire. later reconcile in billing job.

alicia: action items: 1) I'll draft a short RFC w/ header format, HMAC example, canary plan. 2) oli will prototype in stitcher for in-mem mapping. 3) maya to pick metrics and query examples. set 1-week sync. anyone else?

maya: +1

oli: +1, will start a branch.

ben: +1, will sketch reconciliation job changes.

sasha: +1 — i'll draft edge validation rules.

alicia: thanks all — i'll post RFC link when ready and tag this thread. :rocket:
